item.title: Casdoor Authenticated Path Traversal to Arbitrary File Write (CVE-2026-6815)

Field Value

Language / Platform Python PoC
Authentication Required Yes (admin or equivalent user with storage-provider create/edit access)
Network Access Required Yes (HTTP to Casdoor instance)

Summary

Casdoor’s Local File System storage provider fails to properly sanitize the pathPrefix configuration and fullFilePath parameter during resource uploads. An authenticated administrator (or equivalent privileged user) can use directory traversal sequences to escape the configured storage directory and write arbitrary files anywhere the Casdoor process has filesystem permissions — enabling RCE (e.g. via SSH authorized_keys injection) or DoS (overwriting the application database or core binaries).
